title: Mechanical robustness QA and objective fixes
purpose: Validate and harden the non-visual Filter Controller contracts before Guilherme runs complex Elementor visual QA.
objective: Use a reproducible WP-CLI harness to cover mechanical robustness checks and patch failures in Sort style and resolver semantics.
scope_boundary: In scope: WP-CLI harness, style cadence checks, dynamic tag/preset checks, resolver source/compare/dataType checks, sort ordering checks, and objective code fixes. Out of scope: browser screenshot QA, motion judgment, multi-click Elementor usability judgment, and full per-filter visual redesign.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-046 is complete and tests TEST-FC-ROBUSTNESS-001 through TEST-FC-ROBUSTNESS-010 are pending.
exit_condition: TASK-FC-047 is implemented, validated, documented, committed, and pushed in the plugin repository.
completion_criteria: Harness exists in the plugin repository.
Harness restores temporary CPT and preset state after execution.
Sort Style section exists and is gated by show_sort.
FilterResolver supports source, compare, and dataType payload fields.

phases.title: Objective fixes
phases.purpose: Patch mechanical failures discovered by the harness.

phases.title: Evidence
phases.purpose: Record mechanical pass counts and human QA boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: No visual/editor-heavy check is marked as mechanically passed.
No persistent local CPT or preset fixture remains after the harness run.
Legacy filter behavior remains compatible when compare is empty.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
stop_conditions: The harness mutates persistent site state without restoring it.
The implementation attempts to claim browser visual QA without screenshots or Guilherme notes.
Compare semantics break legacy type-based filtering.
